title: omen overview
description: omen run verdicts and agent state-machine walk from official OTel spans (omen.run / omen.step.*). Import via scripts/setup_dashboard.py or SigNoz UI → Import JSON.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT attributes_string['omen.verdict'] AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'omen.run' AND timestamp BETWEEN $start_datetime AND $end_datetime AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT attributes_string['omen.recommendation'] AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'omen.run' AND timestamp BETWEEN $start_datetime AND $end_datetime AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

widgets.title: the reading (latest runs)
widgets.description: Client k6 metrics joined to SigNoz correlate fields on each omen.run span

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT timestamp, attributes_string['omen.verdict'] AS verdict, attributes_string['omen.worst_path'] AS endpoint, attributes_string['omen.k6_p95_ms'] AS client_p95_ms, attributes_string['omen.k6_failed_pct'] AS client_failed_pct, attributes_string['omen.srv_p95_ms'] AS server_p95_ms, attributes_string['omen.srv_5xx'] AS server_5xx, attributes_string['omen.root_cause'] AS root_cause, attributes_string['omen.forecast_p95_ms'] AS forecast_p95_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'omen.run' AND timestamp BETWEEN $start_datetime AND $end_datetime AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10

widgets.title: the agent's walk — Burr state machine, latest run

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: WITH latest AS (SELECT trace_id FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'omen.run' AND timestamp BETWEEN $start_datetime AND $end_datetime AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT attributes_string['omen.seq'] AS seq, attributes_string['omen.card'] AS card, attributes_string['omen.phase'] AS phase, attributes_string['omen.status'] AS status, attributes_string['omen.tool_calls'] AS calls, attributes_string['omen.tools'] AS tools FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE trace_id GLOBAL IN (SELECT trace_id FROM latest) AND name LIKE 'omen.step.%' AND timestamp BETWEEN $start_datetime AND $end_datetime AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp ORDER BY toUInt64OrZero(attributes_string['omen.seq']) ASC

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'omen.run' AND timestamp BETWEEN $start_datetime AND $end_datetime AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts ASC

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT attributes_string['omen.verdict'] AS verdict, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'omen.run' AND timestamp BETWEEN $start_datetime AND $end_datetime AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp GROUP BY verdict ORDER BY value DESC
